facts.subject: Protected-main enforcement and review configuration
facts.claim: The repository has one direct human collaborator/owner and no repository teams; protected main requires strict up-to-date governance, quality, unit-coverage, CodeQL, and both Developer Portability OS check contexts, with administrator enforcement enabled. Required PR reviews, conversation-resolution enforcement, rulesets, and CODEOWNERS are not configured.
facts.source: GitHub REST collaborators, teams, branch-protection, required-status-checks, and repository-rulesets read-back for faresmohamed260/renderlab; expected settings are recorded in docs/governance/github-protection.json.
action_contexts: changing branch protection, required checks, review policy, or rulesets
using GitHub enforcement state as acceptance or governance evidence
